summary: Ground explicit RFI/Submittal form Subject claims to one complete value and the same exact workflow identity.
decision_refs: The active objective requires accurate file-grounded questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
An offline reproduction proved that a correct RFI form Subject answer was rejected by the former Email-only Subject guard
A separate workflow-scoped Subject check enables the valid answer while retaining fail-closed identity and source boundaries
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded accuracy and adaptability improvements to the existing file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: Only explicit Subject claims paired with an exact RFI/Submittal identity enter this guard; generic topic or title prose remains outside it.
Only evidence conservatively classified as RFI or Submittal can ground a workflow Subject; an Email Subject header remains Email metadata.
Case, repeated whitespace, outer quotation marks and answer-ending punctuation outside the value normalize while quoted punctuation stays exact.
A Subject-only source quotation may use one exact evidence-locator identity; a multi-identity locator remains insufficient.
The guard does not infer applicability, status, revision, authority, semantic paraphrase equivalence or a controlling source.
